## Discussion Questions

1. Is the connection between culture and applicants' stories seen in applications? How has it changed?
2. Should employers treat AI-assisted resumes differently from fully human-written resumes? Why or why not?
3. Does access to AI technology create an unfair advantage for some applicants?

5. Should there be limits on how much AI can be used in the hiring process?
